svg.title: ESGE Domicile
svg.desc: live. Home services, from quote to invoice. Three workspaces: clients, service providers, and the team. Access rules enforced in the database with Row Level Security. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL · RLS, ~230 Playwright tests.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
